description: Reproducibility registry for external data used or staged for v0.9 corpus ingestion. Archives themselves stay OUT of the repo (gitignored under data_sources/archives/ and other external paths); this manifest pins their URL and SHA-256 so any run can re-fetch and verify the exact bytes. Licensed/sample data is for local research use and is never redistributed via this repo. WordNet and any lexical/semi-formal source enters the ontology at `empirical`, never grounds a frame verdict, and never appears in `verified_by`. Language key for the corpusdata.org groups (verified by content, not just URL): `corpusdata-span` = SPANISH (Corpus del Espanol), `corpusdata-wiki` = ENGLISH (Wikipedia Corpus), `corpusdata-coca` = ENGLISH (COCA). The span/wiki basename collision (database/wordLemPoS/text.zip) is disambiguated by SHA-256; the Spanish files are the local `(1).zip` copies.

Four maths files, not a whole-repo pin of a moving master. Extracted by scripts/ingest_algorithms.py into data_sources/derived/algorithms/extract.json.
